_comment: Packages allowed to run an npm lifecycle script (preinstall/install/postinstall) on `npm ci`, checked by scripts/check-install-scripts.mjs. A dependency (direct or transitive) that gains one of these scripts and isn't listed here fails CI — lifecycle scripts run arbitrary code at install time with no review, the classic supply-chain injection vector, so adding a new one here should get its own look in the PR that introduces it.
